en.html:
Not pitch-dark, no. But the dimness had closed around the room, and I could feel people entering without a sound. Several... ten. More than ten, actually; the counting itself was falling behind.

No queue, no formation. Each seemed to settle wherever he pleased. Yet, whether by intention or otherwise, their scattered positions surrounded me and the few people nearby.
en.text:
Not pitch-dark, no. But the dimness had closed around the room, and I could feel people entering without a sound. Several... ten. More than ten, actually; the counting itself was falling behind.

No queue, no formation. Each seemed to settle wherever he pleased. Yet, whether by intention or otherwise, their scattered positions surrounded me and the few people nearby.

ja.html:
暗闇ではない、だが薄闇に閉ざされた空間に、複数
の人間が音もなく踏み入ってくる気配があった。
　数人……十人、いやもっと多い。

　彼らは並ぶことも、陣形を取ることもなく、勝手に
思い思いの場所へ身を置いた様子だ。
　しかし、意図してかどうか――俺そして付近の数人
を取り囲むように広がっていた。

en.html:
Only clapping answered, in a room where we could not even see each other's faces. Approval, presumably. I took it as such.

Taali bajao. Clap, and nobody need know who agreed to what. A remarkably convenient arrangement. Ordinarily a man had to attach his face to his opinion and carry both home afterward. Here, only the hands had attended. If the opinion became embarrassing later, the face could deny the whole thing. Never met these hands in my life. They were clapping independently.

en.html:
Wolf"A hidden hand behind the continental economy. A big leader of a new religion. A serial murderer who was supposed to have been executed—supposed to, please note. A film star whose name everybody knows."
Wolf"A retired soldier, a clown, a vast landowner, a person with multiple personalities, the head of a financial conglomerate, a physicist, a priest, a high-class courtesan, an expelled Zen monk, a young fellow who made a fortune in shares and now cannot find a use for the money, a genius cook, an astrologer—"
Wolf"All different. Completely different. Even nationality and race have refused to form a proper set."
Wolf"What gathering is this, bhai? Did somebody put the whole human race in a lucky draw and pull out this lot?"
Kageaki"..."
Wolf"No, no. A wish brought us together."
Wolf"For one single desire, all this mismatched humanity has assembled."
Kageaki"And what desire is that?"
Wolf"God."
Wolf"God, I am saying!"
Green Dragon Society Member A"God... haan, God."
Green Dragon Society Member B"If such a thing is there, I would most certainly like to see it."
Green Dragon Society Member C"God only. Nothing else is holding my interest now..."
Green Dragon Society Member D"I need God. To reject this sinful self of mine, entirely. Nothing left over."
Green Dragon Society Member E"Love people, hate people, raise them, kill them, torment them—bas! Bored of the entire human business! Give me something that is not human. I want to see God!"
Green Dragon Society Member F"Arre, as a joke it would be unbeatable, no? 'Turns out God was actually there!'"
Green Dragon Society Member G"Kaa-ha-ha!! God doesn't exist! And if he does, I'll bloody kill him!"
Green Dragon Society Member H"God, at least, will surely love me."
Green Dragon Society Member I"God..."
Green Dragon Society Member J"God—"
Green Dragon Society Member K"God!"

ウォルフ「大陸経済界の黒幕。 　新興宗教の大幹部。 　処刑されたはずの連続殺人犯。 　その名を知らぬ者はいない銀幕スター」
ウォルフ「退役軍人、道化師、大地主、多重人格者、 財閥のトップ、物理学者、神父、高級娼婦、 禅宗の破門僧、株で大儲けしたものの使い道 がない青年、天才料理人、占星術師――」
ウォルフ「バラバラだ。全くバラバラだ。 　人種や国籍さえ統一されていない」
ウォルフ「一体、これは何の集団だ？ 　全人類からクジか何かで選ばれて集まった だけか？」
景明「…………」
ウォルフ「違うね……。 　我々を結集したのは願いだ」
ウォルフ「ただ一つの欲求のため、我々は集った」
景明「それは何だ」
ウォルフ「神」
ウォルフ「神だよ！」
緑龍会Ａ「神……そう神だ」
緑龍会Ｂ「そんなものがいるなら是非とも見たいね」
緑龍会Ｃ「もう神くらいしか興味はない……」
緑龍会Ｄ「神が必要です。 　罪深き私を完膚なく否定するために」
緑龍会Ｅ「人間を愛するのも憎むのも育てるのも殺す のも嬲るのも、何もかも飽きた！ 　人ならぬものに会いたい。神を見たい！」
緑龍会Ｆ「いやぁギャグとして最高だと思うんだよね。 『神様は本当にいたんです！』っての」
緑龍会Ｇ「カァーーカカッ!! 　神なんていねえ！　いたら殺す！」
緑龍会Ｈ「神様ならきっと、わたしを愛してくれる」
緑龍会Ｉ「神を……」
緑龍会Ｊ「神を――」
緑龍会Ｋ「神を！」

en.html:
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"Kaisa laga, bhai? World's most useless kachra, all collected in one place. Premium selection."
Chachamaru"Humans don't do it for them anymore. Unless they cling to something called God, these fellows cannot get through life."
Chachamaru"And for that, they'll do anything."
Kageaki"...Anything?"
Chachamaru"One more thing this lot have in common, apart from the purpose. They can move money and people. Both."
Chachamaru"With that power they'll support us from behind the scenes. What you and apun are going to do—"
Chachamaru"Our plan to make the Silver Star, our Princess, into a god."
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"Originally, just an occult society. People fed up with living, passing time with magic and alchemy. Timepass with ceremonial dignity. But now it is a little different..."
Wolf"A few developments took place."
Wolf"First, I reasoned out that God exists. At that stage, however, even I was not confident my paper was correct."
Wolf"My own paper I had to call a Reverie. Confidence was not coming, so a dream had to stand in its place. But then—"
Chachamaru"Then apun read Wolf's paper."
Chachamaru"And apun had already sensed that God exists."
Kageaki"Sensed...?"
Chachamaru"Apun can hear it. The voice..."
Chachamaru"Wasn't born human, bhai. Voices humans can't hear, those reach apun."
Chachamaru"That saala screaming his head off underneath the earth."
Kageaki"..."

ja.html:
景明「…………」
茶々丸「どうよお兄さん。 　世にもくだらねー屑どもばっかだろ？」
茶々丸「こいつら、もう人間じゃ満足できないんだ。 　神なんてもんにすがらないと人生やってけ ねえ」
茶々丸「そのためなら何だってする気でいる」
景明「……何でも？」
茶々丸「今ここにいる連中には、目的のほかにもう いっこ共通項があってね。 　金と人間を動かせる・・・・・・・・・っていう」
茶々丸「こいつらはその力で裏からサポートする。 　あてとお兄さんがこれからやることを――」
茶々丸「銀星号おひめを神にする計画を」
景明「…………」
茶々丸「この会は元々、生きるのに飽きたやつらが 集まって手慰みの魔術やら錬金術やらに耽る、 オカルト結社でしかなかった。 　でも、今は少し違う……」
ウォルフ「いくつかの出来事があった」
ウォルフ「まず、僕が神の実在を推論したこと。 　……けれどこの時は、僕自身が論文の正否 について自信を欠いていた」
ウォルフ「僕は自分の論文に、夢想論・・・と題さなくては ならなかった。 　だが、しかし――」
茶々丸「そのウォルフの論文を、あてが読んだ」
茶々丸「既に神の存在を感受していた・・・・・・・・・・・・・あてが」
景明「感受……？」
茶々丸「あてには聴こえるんだ。 　声が……」
茶々丸「あてはヒトとして生まれなかったから。 　ヒトには聴こえない声が聴こえる」
茶々丸「地の底でぎゃあぎゃあ・・・・・・騒いでる奴の声がね」
景明「…………」

What on earth was she saying? This question must have spread across my face so thoroughly that even the dark could not cover it.

Chachamaru seemed to grin. A terrible grin; darkness was doing me no favor there either.
